title.quote:
Training Plug-and-Play Knowledge Modules
with Deep Context Distillation
title.value: Training Plug-and-Play Knowledge Modules with Deep Context Distillation

extractions.description: The paper proposes document-level Knowledge Modules (KMs) implemented as LoRA adapters, trained with a Deep Context Distillation (DCD) objective that matches hidden states and logits of a teacher conditioned on the document. It evaluates on QuALITY, NarrativeQA and LongHealth with Phi-3 3B and Llama-3.1 8B, comparing against next-token prediction, pre-instruction tuning, ICL and RAG, and studies synthetic data generation (summaries, QA pairs, Entigraph).

type.quote: We evaluate our method on two long-context question answering datasets (QuALITY and NarrativeQA) and two base models (Phi-3 3B and Llama-3.1 8B) in two settings: open book and closed book evaluation.
type.justification: The paper reports experimental results across datasets and models.
